Surely nothing could go wrong...|Special Gamemode Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Pizza Party''' is a [[Maps|map]] that takes place in a pizzeria. This map uses its own mode for the wave structure, enemy statistics and rewards. It is a special map, meaning that it can only be played using the special mode [[Matchmaking]]. The statue has a level requirement of {{Level|25}} to be used. Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to them. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. For example, the [[Executioner (Pizza Party)|Executioner]] gives {{Money|1,000}} every 1% health in solo, {{Money|500}} in duo, {{Money|333}} in trio and {{Money|250}} in quad. The health of enemies in this mode scales with the player count, starting at three players. The increase is 15% in duo, 25% in trio and 35% in quad. It is applied after attributes, like [[Bloated]], meaning they can affect the health of an enemy. This map has the [[HP Locked]], [[Pizza Party (Modifier)|Pizza Party]], [[Blood]] and [[Mutation]] modifiers, and an additional [[Lost Souls]] modifier under specific circumstances. [[Pizza Party (Modifier)|Pizza Party]] modifier changes multiple enemies into their pizzeria versions, which can also increase their health by 6% with each wave due to the [[Mutation]] modifier. Enemies also have a chance to spawn with animal masks and a Dream mask because of the [[Pizza Party (Modifier)|Pizza Party]] modifier. The [[Blood]] modifier makes enemies splatter blood onto the ground upon death. The base health is also set to 200, regardless of the players' [[Skills]], due to the [[HP Locked]] modifier. The [[Lost Souls]] modifier can only be activated when every player in the server has the [[Scout]]/[[Golden Scout]], [[Shotgunner]], [[Commander]] and [[Minigunner]]/[[Golden Minigunner]] in their loadout. The fifth tower can be any tower. This modifier makes the map turn black and white. All enemies now have their defense increased by 20%. Additionally, it increases the amount of enemies spawning in each wave by 50%, always rounding down when spawning. Triumphing '''Pizza Party''' makes the [[Warden]] available for purchase in the shop for {{Coins|4,000}}. Triumphing with the [[Lost Souls]] modifier active grants you the {{Color|Other|Slaughter}} skin for the [[Warden]], which can be claimed through the [[Gift Box]] menu. ==Design & Path== '''Pizza Party''' is a pizzeria with a dark, eerie atmosphere. It has grey walls with multiple white clouds on them. The floor of the building varies depending on the section of it, either being multiple tiles or a carpet. There is a large stage for [[Wox the Fox]], with purple curtains, speakers and a large hole in the wall, with fire on the other side. Multiple tables can be seen across the map, with presents, cakes, pizza and party hats on them. There is an area of the building which contains multiple games, like a ball pit, arcade games and a spinning wheel. There is also a small playground area next to it. On the back of the map there is a door with white light coming out of it with a dumpster near it, with it being the exit for enemies. Multiple cardboard boxes and balloons can also be seen on the map. The path starts at the hole in the wall and ends at the exit door. The path takes multiple turns, avoiding any obstacles. ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Pizza Party}} ==Rewards== ''For former rewards, see this map's [[Pizza Party/Rewards|Rewards]] page.'' The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. For example, one [[Scout (Pizza Party)|Scout]] still appears on Wave 10, but three [[Scout (Pizza Party)|Scout]]s appear on Wave 18 instead of two. It also increases the defense of all enemies by 20%. '''Bolded''' names indicates an enemy type's debut.

==Strategy== ===Regular Matches=== * Early on, cheap towers with high DPS are recommended, such as the [[Trapper]], [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Brawler]] or [[Golden Cowboy]]. *High DPS towers, such as the [[Pursuit]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Ranger]] or [[Accelerator]] are recommended. **As multiple enemies in this map have [[Flying]], [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] or [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]], having all three detections is quite important here. *** The [[Firework Technician]], [[UAV]] and [[Ace Pilot]] can be used to give these detections permanently or temporarily, if needed. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be quite useful at boosting the firerate and range of these towers. ***The [[DJ Booth]] may also mitigate the [[Scared Debuff]] applied by [[Wox the Fox]] on the final wave, while the [[Commander]] can mitigate the [[Fatigue Debuff]] from the [[Clown]]s. * Later on in the game, multiple enemies will spawn that can stun multiple towers. Because of this, the [[Medic]]'s ''Cleansing'' ability can be quite useful at cleansing stuns from towers. ===Lost Souls Matches=== *Be aware of the changes to wave structure. Some waves may spawn more enemies than expected, so it is important to be prepared for these waves. *Triggering the [[Lost Souls]] modifier on '''Pizza Party''' requires each player to bring the [[Scout]]/[[Golden Scout]], [[Shotgunner]], [[Commander]] and [[Minigunner]]/[[Golden Minigunner]] with them. The fifth tower in the loadout can be any tower. **Towers with flying detection are needed, as the only tower to have it is the [[Commander]] and its units. Lead detection towers could also be useful, as without golden perks only the [[Shotgunner]] and [[Commander]] have it, though the [[Golden Scout]] does gain lead detection with its perk. *As every enemy gain 20% defense, defense melting towers, such as the [[Pyromancer]]/[[Golden Pyromancer]] and [[Electroshocker]] can be useful. **A [[DJ Booth]] is extremely helpful, especially since [[Farm]]s are generally off-limits, making the discount buff all the more useful. Its [[Range Buff]] can also partially negate [[Wox the Fox]]'s ''Game Over'' ability, which afflicts a [[Scared Debuff]] on all towers. *Both the [[Golden Scout]] and [[Shotgunner]] are viable options for the early game. *The [[Golden Minigunner]] is recommended for its high DPS later on. **Do note that the [[Minigunner]] is cheaper to place than the [[Golden Minigunner]], which may make it more useful in the early waves. *The [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability should be chained. Only one player needs to use the [[Commander]]. *It is very likely that [[Wox the Fox]] will reach the latter half of the map, requiring you to move your [[Minigunner]]s/[[Golden Minigunner]]s to the other side of the map. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} PizzaPartyIcon.png|First icon (31 October 2022 - 21 June 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} TDSHalloween2022Thumbnail.png|'''Pizza Party''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} HalloweenPI1.jpg|'''Pizza Party''' on a promotional image. Tower Defense Simulator- Halloween 2022 Trailer|'''Pizza Party''' in the game trailer. }} ==Trivia == *The method of activating [[Lost Souls]] (having the specified towers in all players' inventories) is based on enemies that appear on this map, these being the [[Scout (Pizza Party)|Scout]], [[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]], [[Commander (Pizza Party)|Commander]] and [[Minigunner (Pizza Party)|Minigunner]]. **While the [[Executioner (Pizza Party)|Executioner]] was added later on, it is not required for the activation. ***It was at one point planned to be added to the loadout if [[Lost Souls]] was activated, but that never happened. *This map is based on the pizzeria that appears in the first ''Five Nights at Freddy's'' game known as the ''[[w:c:freddy-fazbears-pizza:Freddy Fazbear's Pizza|Freddy Fazbear's Pizza]].'' **Multiple enemies are also based on enemies from ''Five Night at Freddy's''. **Multiple hats are put on enemies, which are mostly based on animatronics from various games from the franchise. **Before the [[v1.51.0]] version, five [[Knight]]s used to spawn at Wave 20, which was also a reference to [https://youtu.be/20BNcOvLSfk?si=eoLbCHFhbldioeks this ''Five Nights at Freddy's'' meme]. *Originally, present enemies like the [[Present3 (Krampus Frosthold)|Present3]] were meant to be used as the breaker replacements, though the idea was not accepted. *The ambience volume setting does not control the volume of the ambient track that plays on this map. **Some enemies originated from the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''31 October 2022''' -
